extracted.intended_audience: United Way of Central Ohio staff, agency and program staff, designers, and vendors creating branded communications
extracted.subtask_description: Brand identity and visual-style guidelines for United Way of Central Ohio, covering correct logo use, fonts, templates, and color specifications for print and digital materials. Intended to ensure consistent appearance and protect the organization's brand equity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep white box around logo on colored backgrounds
rubrics_metrics.description: keep the white box around the logo when placed on a colored background.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the logo retains its white containment area whenever it appears on a colored field to preserve legibility and brand integrity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult marketing staff for assistance
rubrics_metrics.description: consult with United Way of Central Ohio Marketing staff for assistance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact marketing for questions about logo usage, color reproduction, or when adapting the brand for special materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not stretch or distort the logo
rubrics_metrics.description: stretch or distort the logo. (listed under 'Please don't...')
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always scale the entire logo proportionally; do not skew, stretch, or otherwise alter the aspect ratio.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum logo size
rubrics_metrics.description: make the logo smaller than 3/4 inch wide. (listed under 'Please don't...')
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not reproduce the logo at widths less than 0.75 inches to maintain legibility and recognition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not change logo color
rubrics_metrics.description: change the color of the logo. (listed under 'Please don't...')
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always use the approved full-color or approved one-color logo versions; do not recolor or apply non-approved color treatments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restrictions on one-color black logo
rubrics_metrics.description: use the one-color black logo on web sites, in e-mails, or on documents which will be printed in color. (listed under 'Please don't...')
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reserve the one-color black logo for appropriate one-color print scenarios; do not use it in color-capable digital or full-color print contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not place elements over or screen the logo
rubrics_metrics.description: place anything on top of the logo, or screen the logo for use as a background. (listed under 'Please don't...')
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep the logo free from overlays, text, graphics, or screen-opacity treatments that reduce clarity or alter appearance; do not use the logo as a patterned background.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not change text location within logo
rubrics_metrics.description: change the location of the text portion of the logo. (listed under 'Please don't...')
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not rearrange, reposition, or separate the logotype from the mark; preserve the approved lockup and relative placement of elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not separate logo elements
rubrics_metrics.description: separate any element of the logo (hand, person, rainbow). (listed under 'Please don't...')
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not extract or use individual components of the brandmark independently; always use the complete, approved logo.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standard typeface: Roboto
rubrics_metrics.description: Roboto is the standard typeface chosen for the United Way brand identity. This font should be used in all printed and online communications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Roboto (Regular, Bold as specified) for consistency with the brandmark and to convey the brand's personality across print and digital materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptable substitute typeface: Arial
rubrics_metrics.description: Arial is an acceptable substitute when Roboto may not be available and is recommended for documents which will be shared in an electronic format other than PDF. Arial can be used in email correspondence, in word-processed documents and for PowerPoint presentations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When Roboto cannot be embedded or distributed (e.g., editable Word docs, email, PowerPoint), use Arial Regular/Bold to maintain visual compatibility; avoid substituting other typefaces.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use specified font weights
rubrics_metrics.description: Roboto Bold / Roboto Regular / Arial Bold / Arial Regular (listed font options).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the prescribed weights for headings and body copy to preserve hierarchy and consistency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use provided electronic templates and logos
rubrics_metrics.description: To assist in the creation of branded documents, templates and logos in various formats are available. United Way staff can find these on the 'P drive' in the 'Branding' folder. Agency and program staff can find them on our website under the 'downloads' tab at the bottom of the page, or by contacting Kristen Miller at 614.227.2753 or kristen.miller@uwcentralohio.org.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the official templates and provided logo files rather than recreating assets; contact the named person or access the specified folders/website to obtain approved files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Color palette: use specified brand colors
rubrics_metrics.description: The United Way color palette is comprised of colors used in the United Way logo. In addition, black, orange, grey and white are included for added flexibility and one-color scenarios. Below you will find specifications for reproducing the United Way colors in a variety of ways.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reproduce brand colors using the provided Pantone, CMYK, RGB and HEX values to ensure accurate and consistent color reproduction across media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Color specifications provided (Pantone/CMYK/RGB/HEX)
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting Elements / Pantone 287, Pantone 659, Pantone 179, Pantone 143 with corresponding CMYK, RGB and HEX values; Black, Spot: Pantone 152, Pantone Black 50%, White and additional RGB/HEX values are listed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the listed numeric color values when preparing files for print or digital use. Use spot/CMYK/RGB/HEX values appropriate to the output medium.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain consistent appearance across media
rubrics_metrics.description: It is important that local United Ways maintain a consistent appearance of the brandmark and all visual communications across various media types and materials. Using colors consistently in all communications will strengthen brand recognition, create impact and differentiate our programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the same color palette, logo treatments, and typography across print, web, email, and presentations to build cohesive brand recognition; avoid ad-hoc color or typography choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pantone accuracy disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: Note: The colors shown on this page and throughout this manual have not been evaluated by Pantone, Inc. for accuracy and may not match the PANTONE Color Standards. For accurate PANTONE Color Standards, refer to the current edition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When precise Pantone matches are required, consult the current Pantone standards rather than relying solely on on-screen or printed samples from this guide.
